view: near-nadir (top-down) drone view of one end of a football pitch; vertical goal line on the right

camera.type: static drone hover with slow drift

inventory.name: ball
inventory.desc: white football, ~3-4 px diameter blob (half-max), dribbled by the yellow player

inventory.name: player_yellow
inventory.desc: player in light yellow/cream kit who starts inside the goal and dribbles the ball out toward the penalty spot (role: possibly the goalkeeper or an attacker; ambiguous)

inventory.name: goalkeeper_dark
inventory.desc: player in dark/black kit standing near the top-left of the goal area in front of the goal (keeper-like position), later walks down-left

inventory.name: goal
inventory.desc: full-size goal frame on the goal line (right side of the pitch), white

inventory.name: dark_object_by_goal
inventory.desc: dark object (bag/ball bag?) just above the top post, ~(388,408), ~8x8 px

inventory.name: penalty_arc
inventory.desc: D-arc left of the penalty area

inventory.name: touchlines_and_corners
inventory.desc: pitch boundary lines top y~47, bottom y~883, corner arcs at goal line

inventory.name: right_strip_netting_and_small_goals
inventory.desc: beyond the goal: sunlit orange netting/fence strip x~432-475,y~258-668 with small white training goals at about (452,198), (447,340), (455,632); adjacent pitch with a goal at x~482-522,y~410-511 (right edge)

inventory.name: shadows
inventory.desc: long diagonal tree/structure shadows across the pitch from upper-left to lower-right; players cast long shadows toward +y (down)

static.coords: frame-0 image pixels (x right, y down); camera drift <= 2.6 px, see camera_motion.csv

goal.note: posts seen from above as white horizontal bars at y~414.6 and ~512.4; goal-line bar x~381; a bright band x~394-401 is the elevated crossbar displaced by parallax; back frame x~407-408 => apparent goal depth ~27 px (includes parallax).

static.image_rotation_deg: markings rotated ~0.4-0.6 deg (goal line x 380.2@y70 -> 385.9@y860; top touchline y 48.7@x50 -> 45.7@x350)

events.event: clip start: ball resting just inside the goal on the goal line area (x~384,y~498); yellow player stands behind it inside the goal; dark player (keeper) standing ~ (349,430) near goal-area top
yellow player reaches the ball (ball and player merge, ball nudged ~2 px toward goal frames 0-10)
ball centre crosses goal line (x~380) leaving the goal, ball low-contrast on the white line frames ~17-20
yellow player centre crosses goal line leaving the goal
start of dribble: ball moving steadily left (-x) with the yellow player, ~0.5-1.4 px/frame, close control (repeated small touches, not resolvable individually)
yellow player centre crosses goal-area front line
dark player (keeper) starts moving: from ~(350,431) drifting down-left (toward +y,-x), continuing to clip end
clip end: ball at (231,467.6 frame-0 coords), ~6 px left/4 px below penalty spot (237,463); ball still moving ~1 px/frame; player right behind it

tracks_columns.x_y: visible centre in raw image px of that frame
tracks_columns.x_stab_y_stab: same in frame-0 (background-stabilized) coords: use these for motion
tracks_columns.mask_length_width: extent along/across mask main axis (top-down footprint incl. limbs, not height)
